title: Check ruling: the catalog re-cut's frozen checks rebind to 0068, 0070 and 0078
situation: The catalog re-cut's frozen checks assert the assayer read-only, the removal 0068 names for the reconstitution cut, and compare the catalog against the re-cut's master design, whose architect and three-slot communication-style predate 0070 and 0078. The lead asked for a ruling.
decision: Yes. Only those assertions rebind to the decisions now in force: the assayer holds the harness's default tools; the architect is the operator's principal architect; communication-style gains the ordering slot, set to bottom-line-up-front and fixed for the architect, left unset for roles that state none. No example text changes; each rebound assertion is seen to fail against the old catalog before it is frozen again.
consequences: The re-cut's master design stays as its record; the decisions in force, not the master, are what the rebound checks compare against.
